GrokRemoteMCPTool.description:
A caller-selected remote MCP server that xAI will connect to.

Use at your own risk. The connection is made by xAI's infrastructure,
not by fal; choosing this tool explicitly accepts that trust boundary.
Authentication and headers are masked in fal error metadata and logs.

GrokToolsConfiguration.description:
Typed xAI tools supported by this app's convenience configuration.

Every tool is disabled in the default configuration: the searches must
be switched on via their ``enabled`` flags and ``mcp_servers`` starts
empty. ``file_search`` / collections are intentionally absent and
unsupported due to Zero Data Retention (ZDR) requirements. Caller-side
function tools are likewise absent from the typed configuration — they
require a client that answers callback events over /realtime, so they
remain available only to raw ``session.update`` passthrough clients.
Raw realtime passthrough stays generic except that ZDR-incompatible
tool declarations are rejected in-band.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Generate the Grok voice agent's spoken reply to an uploaded audio file.

One-shot alternative to ``/realtime``: the app connects to xAI,
configures the session (prompt / voice / tools), streams the whole
input recording, requests a single response, and returns the
agent's reply as a WAV file plus its transcript.

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
